Appendix 3
Enforcement Decree of the Act on the Promotion of and Support for Environmental Education [Appendix 3]
Criteria for imposition of administrative fines (related to Article 23)

1. General criteria
(a) The increased criteria for administrative fines based on the number of violations shall apply where an administrative fine has been imposed for the same violation within the preceding year. The period shall be calculated by reference to the date on which the administrative fine was imposed for the violation and the date on which the same violation committed again after that disposition was detected.
(b) When imposing an increased administrative fine under item (a), the applicable violation tier shall be the tier immediately following that of the fine imposed before the violation (where two or more administrative fines were imposed within the period specified in item (a), the highest such tier). A disposition imposed more than one year before the date of detection shall be excluded when determining the tier for an increased fine.
(c) The imposing authority may reduce the amount of an administrative fine under the individual criteria in subparagraph 2 by up to one-half in any of the following cases; provided, no reduction may be granted to a violator who is in arrears on administrative fines:
1) Where the violation is deemed attributable to minor negligence or error;
2) Where it is recognized that the violator has made efforts to correct or remedy the state of violation;
3) Where a reduction is otherwise deemed necessary, taking into account the severity of the violation, its motive and consequences, etc.
(d) The imposing authority may increase the amount of an administrative fine under the individual criteria in subparagraph 2 by up to one-half in any of the following cases. The amount shall not exceed the maximum administrative fine prescribed in Article 34(1) through (3) of the Act:
1) Where the nature and severity of the violation are serious and the resulting harm to citizens, etc. is deemed substantial;
2) Where the violation has continued for at least six months;
3) Where an increase is otherwise deemed necessary, taking into account the severity of the violation, its motive and consequences, etc.

2. Individual criteria
Unit: 10,000 won

| Violation | Statutory basis | First violation | Second violation | Third or subsequent violation |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| (a) Using the title of an environmental educator in violation of Article 16(5) of the Act | Article 34(1) of the Act | 150 | 250 | 300 |
| (b) Failing to receive continuing training in violation of Article 18(1) of the Act | Article 34(2) of the Act | 50 | 80 | 100 |
| (c) Using a designation mark or a similar mark on an environmental education program that has not been designated, in violation of Article 21(6) of the Act | Article 34(3) of the Act | 10 | 15 | 20 |
